featured_reviews.name: Yaana Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text: Nirmala Mata Church, located in Vasai, Maharashtra, is a Roman Catholic church dedicated to the Immaculate Mother of God. This beautiful church is a site for Catholic devotees, attracting visitors from far and wide with its stunning architecture and peaceful ambiance. The church's significance extends beyond its aesthetic appeal, serving as a spiritual heaven where devotees seek guidance, and connection with the divine. The feast of Our Lady of Immaculate Conception is celebrated with great fervor, drawing large crowds. Throughout the year, the church offers various facilities, including daily Mass, confession, baptism, and marriage ceremonies. The church also engages in community services. Nirmala Mata Church is conveniently located in Vasai West, Maharashtra, making it easily accessible by road and rail. Devotees can reach the church via state highways or alight at Vasai Railway Station, which is just a short distance away. In addition to its spiritual significance, Nirmala Mata Church is surrounded by popular attractions, including Vasai Fort, Vasai Beach. These nearby landmarks offer a unique blend of history, culture, and natural beauty, making Vasai an ideal destination for tourists and pilgrims alike.

featured_reviews.name: Preetham Dsilva
featured_reviews.review_text: A very small church with a very BIG heart! Fell in love with the church and the vibe it had the very first time i went there over 10 years ago. It is a small parish with very few parishioners. But because of the Redemptorist priests that are in charge of the Parish, it is very popular, and people from nearby parishes flock to it for Sunday masses and even more for Christmas, Holy Week etc. The priests are warm, welcoming and make it a point to meet all the people after every service. It is also very popular for the Wednesday novena to Our Lady of Perpetual Succour in English at 7.15 pm. Compared to some of the massive, ancient churches in Vasai, this one is very small, and pretty new.

Large number of devotees from different parts of Mumbai comes to the church during this period seeking blessings of of mother Mary.

featured_reviews.name: Libin Thomas
featured_reviews.review_text: St. Mary's Jacobite Syrian Orthodox Church is a Malankara Jacobite Church under the Holy See of the Antioch. This is a beautiful church designed in old Kerala Church Architecture and was consecrated in the year 2002. The church is blessed to have with her the Holy Girdle of St. Mary and the same is interred here in the church. The Holy Girdle is kept for public veneration during St. Mary's Feast in the month of September. Visiting this church has always been a blessed experience for all the people coming to the church.

featured_reviews.name: Pius Lopes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Church of St. Roque
Erected in 1943 (ref: Catholic Diocese of Vasai)

History can safely record that this parish was founded as a result of a promise made to St. Roque by the people of Gokhivare. In 1914 the village was severely affected by an epidemic of cholera. The Catholics made a vow to build a chapel in honor of St. Roque.
Two hundred villagers kept their promise and built a 40’ by 18’ structure to which the Archibishop Lima added a 18’ by 15 Sancury. On June 30, 1930, the Dean of South Bassein blessed the chapel, which was still under the jurisdiction of St, Michael's, Manickpur.
Gokhivare got its independent parish in 1943 with Father Nubiola S. J as the first parish priest. The parish stayed under the care of the Jesuits, except for the brief period between 1968-71 when Fr. Servulo Vaz, a secular priest was the Vicar.
In 1990 the church was extended on the Northern side. However with large migration of Catholics of Mumbai to Vasai, this parish has been completely demolished and built again into a massive structure from scratch.

Gokhivare, Vasai Rd. (E), Dist Thane 401 208
